subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Pick and Place: Speed and Precision
description: Learn Pick and Place: Speed and Precision in one minute.

hook.text: A delta robot picks 200 chocolates per minute from a conveyor and places each one in a box. Never a miss.

buildup.text: Pick-and-place robots use lightweight arms for maximum speed. They grab, move, and release in fractions of a second.

discovery.text: Vision systems find each item on the belt. The robot calculates the grab point in real time as items move past.

twist.text: Soft grippers handle fruit without bruising. Vacuum cups lift flat items. Each product needs its own end effector.

climax.text: Electronics, food, and pharmaceutical factories use pick-and-place robots for tasks too fast for human hands.

punchline.text: See it. Grab it. Place it. 200 times a minute.

quiz.question: How do pick-and-place robots handle items moving on a conveyor belt?
options: The belt stops briefly for each pick to ensure accuracy
Vision systems locate items in real time and the robot calculates grab points on the fly
Items are pre-positioned in fixed slots so the robot always grabs the same spot
